name: io.github.evrenta/mcp
description: MCP server for Evrenta Notes spaces, pages, search, revisions, and Boards tasks

environmentVariables.name: APP_API_URL
environmentVariables.description: URL of your notes service (defaults to http://localhost:3000)

environmentVariables.name: APP_API_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Scoped notes service agent token created in Profile > API tokens

environmentVariables.name: APP_BRAND_NAME
environmentVariables.description: Optional notes product display name used in tool descriptions

environmentVariables.name: BOARD_BRAND_NAME
environmentVariables.description: Optional Boards display name used in tool descriptions
